title: Tenure Relief on Northgate Cash Reversals
content:
**Rule.** Under the consumer return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the member's tenure on the return date adds to the relief fraction of the reversal, measured in whole calendar months from the membership's term start date to the return date:

- a return dated **24** or more whole calendar months after the term start date adds **0.1**;
- a return dated **12** to fewer than **24** whole calendar months after it adds **0.05**;
- any other return adds nothing.

A whole calendar month is counted when the return date reaches the same day of the month as the term start date. Where the membership record carries no term start date, the return adds nothing.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical term start date 9 July 2029)**

| Return date | Whole calendar months | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 8 July 2030 | 11 | nothing |
| 9 July 2030 | 12 | 0.05 |
| 8 July 2031 | 23 | 0.05 |
| 9 July 2031 | 24 | 0.1 |
